steps.say: Past the fallen gate the road turns to grass, and the air goes sweet. Blossom drifts on it. After the Works it is almost too much to breathe.
A beekeeper in a veil puffs smoke at a hive stand that isn't there any more. Under the veil, something shines like wet candle.
The hives still hum. Strike one and the bees come out angry, and they will not tell you from whoever burned their orchard.
